sources.title_original: Microsoft quietly drops Copilot+ branding from new laptops
sources.summary: Microsoft's latest Surface laptops dropped the Copilot+ PC branding despite hitting the minimum requirements. Even high-end AI devices like the Nvidia RTX Spark and Microsoft's own Project Zenith are noticeably missing the label.
sources.summary_zh: 尽管达到了最低要求，微软最新的 Surface 笔记本电脑还是放弃了 Copilot+ PC 品牌。即使是像 Nvidia RTX Spark 和微软自己的 Project Zenith 这样的高端人工智能设备也明显缺少这个标签。

sources.title_en: Enthusiast cooled iPhone 18 Pro with cold can of La Croix sparkling water; benchmarks show 25% higher sustained performance
sources.title_original: Enthusiast cooled iPhone 18 Pro with cold can of La Croix sparkling water; benchmarks show 25% higher sustained performance
sources.summary: Matt Birchler put a cold drink can on the back of an iPhone 18 Pro to see how much performance uplift it would get in a prolonged benchmarking session. The results showed up to 25% higher sustained performance from the cold drink, showing the effectiveness of 'liquid cooling.'
sources.summary_zh: Matt Birchler 将一个冷饮罐放在 iPhone 18 Pro 的背面，看看在长时间的基准测试中它的性能会得到多少提升。结果显示，冷饮的持续性能提高了 25%，显示了“液体冷却”的有效性。

stories.title: 开源 AnyPS5 转储仿真以在 PC 上本地运行 PlayStation 5 主机游戏 / Open-source AnyPS5 dumps emulation to run PlayStation 5 console games natively on PC

sources.title: 开源 AnyPS5 转储仿真以在 PC 上本地运行 PlayStation 5 主机游戏 / Open-source AnyPS5 dumps emulation to run PlayStation 5 console games natively on PC
sources.title_zh: 开源 AnyPS5 转储仿真以在 PC 上本地运行 PlayStation 5 主机游戏
sources.title_en: Open-source AnyPS5 dumps emulation to run PlayStation 5 console games natively on PC
sources.title_original: Open-source AnyPS5 dumps emulation to run PlayStation 5 console games natively on PC
sources.summary: Traditional PS5 emulators attempt to recreate the console's hardware and software environment, but AnyPS5 is experimenting with a compatibility layer that translates PlayStation 5 executables into formats that can run on Windows and Linux.
sources.summary_zh: 传统的 PS5 模拟器试图重新创建控制台的硬件和软件环境，但 AnyPS5 正在尝试使用兼容层，将 PlayStation 5 可执行文件转换为可以在 Windows 和 Linux 上运行的格式。
